name: Interlinkify
author: wpwellconcept

sections.description:
Interlinkify provides internal-link focused reports and workflows for WordPress content teams.

Features:

  • Dashboard metrics for internal linking health
  • Crawled posts and pages overview
  • Orphaned post detection
  • Broken link scanning
  • Click tracking for internal links
  • Heuristic inbound and outbound link suggestions
  • Target keyword tools

This plugin does not send data to third-party AI providers. Heuristic suggestions run locally on your WordPress site.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install via the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate Interlinkify in Plugins.
  3. Open the Interlinkify admin menu to run scans and review reports.
sections.faq:
Does this send content to external AI services?

No. This package does not call OpenAI or other AI APIs. Suggestions are generated with local heuristics.

Do I need a license key?

No. All features in this plugin are fully functional without a license.

  • Initial WordPress.org release with fully functional free features.
